_comment: Copy to <project>/.agent-crew/preflight.json and replace every assertion.
Assert by value, never by claim: 'the tests pass' is nearly worthless because a suite
that silently skips the tests which would have caught a wrong environment reports green.
Name the destructive surface and assert that it is out of reach.

assertions.name: test runner is pointed at the sandbox, in strict mode
the real archive drive is detached
assertions.run: python -c "import os,sys; sys.exit(1 if os.path.exists('E:/') else 0)"

assertions.name: on a working branch, not main
no uncommitted changes carried in from a previous session
